target: 'dir lha rnams rdo rje'i gdan gyi 'dug stangs kyis gnas pa'o/ / dpyid zla 'bring po la sogs pa'i tshes kyi lha mo rnams ni rol pa'i 'dug stangs kyis gnas pa/ rang rang gi bdag po bden bral la sogs pa'i mdog dang phyag mtshan dang dbyibs rnams mtshungs pa de rnams la lta bar byed pa rnams te/ 'dir lha rnams rdo rje'i 'dug stangs kyis gnas pa ste/ nag pa la sogs pa'i tshes kyi lha mo rnams ni rol pa'i rkang stabs kyis gnas pa rang rang gi bdag po bden bral la sogs pa'i sku mdog dang phyag mtshan dang dbyibs rnams dang mtshungs pa de dag la gzigs pa'o/ / de rnams 'khor lo'i dbang phyug la ste/
